message: You know those moments when you find yourself saying, 'I told you so'? Well, I've been reminding my friends about the importance of being prepared for power outages, and it looks like I've got the perfect resource to share! This guide offers practical tips on what to do when the lights go out, from keeping your food fresh to staying safe. It's always better to be ready than to scramble at the last minute, right? What’s your go-to tip for managing a blackout?
